assimilated_repositories.extracted_pattern: Client-side Web Speech API bridging, browser audio queueing, dynamic pitch/rate sliders
Continuous microphone stream chunking, auto-restarting recognition loop, silence/pause boundary heuristics
Token-by-token streaming LLM chat loop, punctuation-boundary acoustic chunking, dynamic interrupt management
Bidirectional WebSocket/WebRTC audio-text message protocol, ephemeral realtime session lifecycle
Real-time audio-to-viseme lip synchronization, phoneme duration mapping, sub-50ms video avatar frame streaming
Sub-100ms WebRTC SFU audio/video media tracks, data channel RPC signaling, voice agent room coordination

acoustic_analysis_pillars.fundamental_frequency_f0: Real-time pitch tracking with delta slope (rising=question/hesitation, falling=statement completion)
acoustic_analysis_pillars.speech_cadence_dynamics: Words/syllables per second calculation for empathetic speed matching (0.85x to 1.25x)
acoustic_analysis_pillars.rms_energy_intensity: Root-mean-square loudness profiling to modulate AI vocal intensity (whisper vs authoritative resonance)
acoustic_analysis_pillars.micro_pause_classification: Turn-taking arbitration differentiating mid-sentence cognitive pause (400-800ms) from turn handover (<250ms)
acoustic_analysis_pillars.conversational_backchannel_filter: Non-interruptive filtering of short affirmative human utterances ('mhm', 'yeah', 'uh-huh') without flushing playback
